title: Length bound for the extracted payload
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, take the second component returned by the aligned pair parser on $x$, or the empty word if parsing is undefined. Its length is at most the length of $x$.
replaced:
For every word $x$, the second component extracted from $x$ under the
self-delimiting pair code (taken empty when $x$ is malformed) has length at
most $\abs{x}$.
